release_notes:
- OSF: uploads now run in the background. You can keep working while your files go up, and a notice shows the progress.
- OSF: creating a new OSF project also runs in the background, and all its folders are now created reliably.
- OSF: new exports: a pre-registration protocol draft (Word), the PRISMA diagram, the included studies (RIS), your extracted data and your meta-analysis results.
- OSF: files that have not changed since your last upload are skipped instead of being uploaded again.
- OSF: fixed pre-registration uploads, file names (files arrived as "0.pdf") and the search for contributors.
- OSF: your OSF token is now stored encrypted, and you can replace it with "Change token" without disconnecting.
- OSF: paste your registration link in the OSF tab and Paper Draft and the project timeline will use it.
- Meta-analysis and Library: after an error, they no longer continue and show a second, misleading message.
- Polyglot Search: the options are now evenly spaced.
